finalText:
**Migration is done.** 36 call sites moved across 12 files.

Two things I left alone on purpose:
- `cache.query` in `lib/cache.js` and its callers. Different thing, same name.
- `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js`. Vendored code gets overwritten on upgrade.

`verify.js` passes: "OK every db.query call site moved to db.execute, and nothing else moved".
